title: Cage Destruction (5x5)
author: NXTMaster
rules:
This puzzle is part of the puzzle pack Chaotic Construction by the Sudoku Skunkworks. I will be uploading the 9x9 version of this puzzle later this week, so please check out the pack in the meantime!

The rules are as follows:

• Chaos Construction: Divide the grid into five regions of contiguous cells. Place a digit from 1-5 in each cell such that no digit repeats in a row, column, or region.

• Cage Destruction: Digits within a cage must have a sum greater than the value in the top left corner of the cage, if given. Every cage must contain at least one repeated digit.

• Overlap Circles: A digit in a circle indicates how many of the (at most) nine cells in the 3-by-3 area centered at that circle are part of both the same cage and the same region as that circle.

Example Puzzle by Myxo

The puzzle is available on both SudokuPad and Penpa. Have fun destroying, and visit The Library of Destruction for more Destruction.
solutionCode: Column 4 (Top to Bottom). Include a "-" to separate values in different regions.
